disclosed_output_deviation.description: A metadata inspection printed the complete security_identity, corporate_actions, manifest identity source and manifest price_source objects. Their nested raw_base64 fields carried encoded original Yahoo responses and encoded derived CSV. The tool output was truncated. This note records the deviation without copying that payload.
disclosed_output_deviation.later_base64_decoding_scope: opaque bytes used only to verify SHA256 against retained source; no JSON or CSV price parsing from decoded bytes
disclosed_output_deviation.subsequent_output_policy: Explicit allowlist of identity, hash, clock, state and counts; never nested source objects.

unsuccessful_native_input.reason: Element coordinate unavailable before input; later observed-coordinate click succeeded

native_gesture_provenance: Native actions are attested by the operator; this independent pass verifies saved requests, committed results and frozen package identities, without operating or replaying the UI.
readback_notes: Two preliminary read-only checks stopped before writing: lock directories required explicit run-/task- filtering, and the HTTP response wrapper omits the ledger operation_id/status fields. Final checks compare actual API result payloads and ledger identities. No economic calculation was performed.
limitations: Each cost/benchmark cell uses independent initial capital; results must not be added into a combined portfolio.
Fixed historical project holdout with a post-freeze encoded-source output deviation retained; not globally unseen, naturally forward out-of-sample, or point-in-time source authentication.
Short descriptive sample; two observer replays are additional validation calculations, not additional product runs.
